transition, active route refresh, aggregate rendering, status, and live sync. hubroutecoordinator already owns route specific loading. livecommunicationscoordinator already owns live chat/messages synchronization. api foundation already separates transport from domain routes and supports timeout/abort semantics. css has already passed route isolation and semantic layer gates in prior work. first implementation wave assembly decomposition create focused factories instead of one giant constructor function: assembly/socialcoreassembly.js — state/api/status/tracker/navigation foundations. assembly/socialidentityassembly.js — identity/profile/network/people/discovery. assembly/socialcommunicationassembly.js — inbox/chat/messages/live facing panels. assembly/socialcreationassembly.js — comments, transformations, creator launch, quick actions. assembly/socialsurfaceassembly.js — activity/privacy/spaces/home. appassembly.js — tiny composition root only. lifecycle decomposition split hubapp.js into truthful collaborators: lifecycle/hubinitializationcoordinator.js — initialization ordering and state subscription. identity/socialidentitytransitioncoordinator.js — alias switch, identity scoped reloads, active route refresh, live resync. ui/hubcontextpresenter.js — active alias/destination/privacy badges and aggregate route independent render. hubapp.js — public facade preserving current methods. cross surface operation truth inspect existing state and api first. if absent, introduce: state/socialoperationledger.js — pending/failed/succeeded operation records by key. state/socialrelationshipmodel.js — normalized follow/mutual/self relation vocabulary. these must be driven by real feature needs and tests, not speculative global abstractions. second implementation wave after first wave is verified, inspect and deepen: networkpanel and related apis for optimistic follow convergence. profilepanel for relationship state and self/other differentiation. peoplepanel + publicdiscovery for search/ranking/pagination consistency. inboxpanel for typed/unread event models. messagespanel and message realtime adapters for delivery/read/reconnect state. chatpanel for explicit realtime/offline status. commentstudio and creator apis for draft persistence and mutation state. spacespanel for membership/role/visibility. non goals no framework migration. no replacement api client. no ornamental inheritance. no public route signature break without traced consumers. no fake websocket semantics if backend transport does not provide them. no visual claim of read/delivery/presence certainty unless backend evidence exists. verification code first. then run existing social hub tests, api foundation tests, syntax checks, import cycle checks, indentation/minification audits, and browser smoke where the adapter returns usable evidence.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two critique — twenty five improvements the awtsmoos renews even the plan that seemed complete; awtsmoos.com therefore asks what hidden fracture would embarrass the next developer if left concealed. 1. do not create assembly modules until constructor signatures are read in full. 2. preserve createsocialhub(root) exactly. 3. preserve hubapp.initialize, identitychanged, navigated, and locationchanged until all callers are traced. 4. do not use object.assign blindly in new authorities; prefer explicit dependency fields where manageable. 5. state subscription must be removable if lifecycle ever supports remounting. 6. initialization ordering must remain discovery → identity → live after actual call stack confirmation. 7. identity switching must reject stale responses from a previous alias. 8. public discovery should not be invalidated merely because private identity changes unless its mode truly depends on alias. 9. promise fan out on identity change should use explicit failure policy rather than one rejected load hiding other successful refreshes. 10. status success must not claim inbox/messages/spaces are ready if their loads failed or were never requested. 11. active route refresh should be data driven instead of independent if statements once all route loaders are confirmed. 12. live sync must happen after identity context mutation and relevant route reload, but should not multiply duplicate subscriptions. 13. relationship vocabulary must distinguish unknown from false. 14. optimistic follow rollback needs the server's previous relation snapshot. 15. network list and profile relation buttons must converge after one mutation. 16. inbox events need stable ids before read/unread logic is added. 17. message delivery/read state must only be introduced if backend returns sufficient evidence. 18. realtime reconnect must preserve one connection owner per transport. 19. abort controllers should be route/identity scoped, not global. 20. draft persistence must avoid storing private content beyond the user's existing browser context and should be bounded. 21. search result ranking must not silently mix incompatible entity kinds without labels. 22. every async panel needs explicit loading/empty/error/offline states. 23. mobile sheets must restore focus to their invoker. 24. new cross domain modules require tests before graduating to shared abstractions. 25. documentation must name both the frontend owner and backend route for each major social flow. revised architecture start with lifecycle/assembly because it is measurable and low risk. use the resulting explicit boundaries to expose real cross surface state duplication, then introduce operation/relationship authorities only where multiple domains prove the need.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — final critique and thirty five further improvements the awtsmoos is not contained by first insight or second; awtsmoos.com lets the third pass cut through attractive abstractions until only verified social contracts remain. 1. read every first wave target completely before rewrite. 2. trace constructor call sites outside social hub before changing paths. 3. trace all direct app. property consumers before changing facade fields. 4. preserve root dom ids and data attributes during architecture work. 5. keep assembly modules free of user flow business logic. 6. keep lifecycle coordinator free of dom rendering details. 7. keep context presenter synchronous and side effect limited to its owned elements. 8. keep identity transition coordinator the only authority for alias scoped refresh fan out. 9. add a monotonic identity generation so old async completions can be ignored. 10. do not abort public loads that do not depend on alias. 11. return structured refresh results so status can report partial failure honestly. 12. separate 'initialized' from 'loaded for current identity'. 13. ensure state change rendering cannot throw and kill the subscriber chain silently. 14. preserve one render pass after initialization. 15. avoid creating coordinator cycles back into hubapp if narrower callbacks suffice. 16. make route loaders a declarative manifest only after their signatures are verified. 17. do not retrofit all panels to a base class unless genuine shared lifecycle exists. 18. prefer composition for panel capabilities. 19. add operation state only to mutations that need optimistic ui. 20. keep failed mutation records bounded/clearable. 21. ensure operation keys include entity identity to prevent cross row collisions. 22. normalize alias ids at api/state boundaries once, not independently in every view. 23. relationship state should be immutable snapshots in rendering paths. 24. discovery pagination should guard duplicate pages and stale mode responses. 25. search should cancel prior queries on new input. 26. debounce is not a substitute for cancellation. 27. inbox unread counters should derive from event records, not separate drifting integers. 28. message unread counters should derive from conversation state where possible. 29. realtime events should carry dedupe keys or be deduped by stable server ids. 30. reconnect must stop when the user changes identity or leaves the relevant live surface if transport ownership requires it. 31. composer retries must not duplicate successful server creations. 32. media upload state must distinguish validation rejection, transport failure, cancellation, and server rejection. 33. accessibility assertions should be added to surface tests for busy/pressed/expanded relationships. 34. documentation examples must use the same public apis that production imports. 35. final browser verification must check narrow/mobile/desktop, focus restoration, zero horizontal document overflow, and console/network errors without claiming unsupported adapter evidence. final decision first write only assembly/lifecycle/context decomposition after full reads and call site tracing. then test. then use the newly explicit boundaries to drive the next social feature wave.
